::: {.callout-note title="Where you are in your learning journey" icon=false}
**Where you come from.** This is where your journey starts.

**What this module adds.** You'll learn how your computer organises files and folders, how to install and update software, and how to keep your work tidy and backed up.

**Why it is valuable.** Many early R problems ("file not found", "package won't install") are really computer-skills problems. A solid base here saves you a lot of frustration later.

**Where it leads.** Next up: [R language](r-language.qmd).
:::

## Planned content

- Files, folders, and paths (absolute vs. relative); file extensions and why they matter
- Downloading, unzipping, and organising course files and datasets
- Installing and updating software (R, RStudio) and what to do when something goes wrong
- Keyboard shortcuts, copy/paste, and searching for help effectively
- Keeping work safe: backups, cloud storage, and handling sensitive data
